note: BH-8062: what the lead review does when a PR body has no selection-gate record (<!-- selection-gate: head=<sha> suites=<n> rc=<rc> -->, rc 0, could-not-run, no-selection or off; rc=off is the record of a build with SELECTION_GATE at 0 and is accepted, written by the builder from bin/selection-gate.sh and refreshed by a resolver fix round) for the PR head, or a record for another head that patch_same does not rebind. It applies only when the PR's merge base carries bin/selection-gate.sh (other repos and PRs built before the gate merged are n/a). block: a builder PR (head branch ticket/*) gets VERDICT BLOCK with no agent call (model none:gate-record); any other branch gets a [NOTE] in the reviewer prompt. note: every refusal is a [NOTE]. off: no check. Any other value is block.
